text.en:
1st-gen automated confessional developed by the Laterano Faith Assistive Engineering Design Bureau. It began as a stationary confessional fitted with a smart voice system, modified and fitted to a mobile chassis allowing it to move through Laterano and respond to the confession requests of citizens on the intercity net.
The classic form is the designer's taste, and gives the user an impression of simplicity and honesty.
The accuracy and response of the voice recognition system were improved, and new customization options were added, including voice types, cognition scope, and response tendencies, providing a more personalized confession experience.
The automated confessional CONFESS-47 (full serial in Curia records: LATERANO AUTOMATED CONFESSIONAL 047) joined Rhodes Island as a gift from the Lateran Curia and currently serves as an operator providing confession and other services to members of Rhodes Island.
text.zh:
由拉特兰信仰辅助器械设计所研发的第一代自律告解车。其原型为搭载了智能语音系统的固定告解室，在经过轻量化改造，并加装动力系统后，得以便捷地在拉特兰城内移动，能够及时响应拉特兰公民通过城际网络发出的告解请求。
外形上，出于设计人员的个人审美，选取了较为复古的造型，致力于给使用者留下“朴实”“诚恳”的印象。
系统上，在改进智能语音系统的识别准度与响应速度的同时，也加入了诸多自定义选项，包括语音类型、认知范畴、响应倾向性等，致力于提供私人化的告解体验。
编号为CONFESS-47（教皇厅归档的完整编号为LATERANO AUTOMATED CONFESSIONAL 047）的自律告解车作为教皇厅的礼物登上罗德岛，现以干员身份定期驻舰，为罗德岛成员提供以听取告解为主的各项服务。

text.en:
'Confession' is a concept unique to the Lateran faith, and unfamiliar to most Rhodes Island operators. People understand it in many different ways: some imagine it as a way to seek comfort by confessing one's sins and asking for forgiveness, while others see it as a way to build trust with God by dissecting one's own sins and seeking punishment. Most agreed, however, that this gift from the Lateran Curia was likely to end up as little more than an accessory in the reception room.
Surprisingly, it took only a few days before long queues started forming in front of CONFESS-47's cabin door, and most of the people lining up were not Laterans. A Lateran Messenger visiting Rhodes Island wrote a 300-page report on this remarkable phenomenon, bringing it back to Laterano to be studied by the priests.
After several months of study and discussion, the priests published a 600-page thesis arguing that confession (specifically as it pertains to confessions conducted with a confessional) is applicable to all of humanity, whether they believe in the Lateran faith or not. In the paper, they wrote:
It is human nature to give things meaning. We give any external stimulus we encounter some sort of positive or negative meaning, using it as a guide for subsequent action. The interaction between human beings is also a catalyst for the creation of such meaning. In particular, the opinions of others significantly influence the direction of such additional meaning. These additional meanings typically remain with an individual for the rest of their life, significantly shaping their views and character...Confession forms a way to eliminate additional meanings that are unnecessary.

'That's way too complicated. The truth is much simpler. Imagine that you put a grain of sand in a clam. It'll begin to secrete nacre and wrap it around the sand, until it no longer stings. But the confessional is a machine. It doesn't secrete anything; all it does is scoop the sand out for the clam and throw it away.'
'In other words, the confessional doesn't judge, whether you're bringing it joy or worry. Talk with it for a while, and you'll realize that whatever's bothering you wasn't that important after all—especially when you're trying to stifle a laugh because of a bad pun CONFESS-47 just made.'
—Exusiai, to operators whose heads were hurting after reading the aforementioned thesis
text.zh:
对于大多数罗德岛干员来说，“告解”这种独属于拉特兰信仰的行为是陌生的，人们对它的认知也五花八门。有人想象告解是“通过诉说罪孽并请求原谅的方式，求得内心的安慰”，也有人认为告解是“通过剖析自身的丑恶并求得惩罚的方式，与神明建立信任关系”。不过，大多数干员都有一个共识——教皇厅赠予罗德岛的这台“告解车”，最终大概只会成为会客室里的一件摆设。
意外的是，在来到罗德岛短短几天后，CONFESS-47的车门前就排起了长队，而长队之中多数都不是拉特兰人。之后来到罗德岛友好访问的拉特兰信使，将这种现象视作奇闻，撰写了整整三百页的报告，带回拉特兰以供修士们研究。
修士们经过数月的研讨，又写出了一篇整整六百页的论文，以证明告解（特指对告解车的告解）行为可以适用于任何现代人类，不论他是否信仰拉特兰教。根据论文所述：
为事物赋予意义乃人类之本性。人会为自身受到的任何外界刺激赋予或正面或负面的意义，以此指导自己之后的行动……人与人之间的互动亦会促进此类附加意义的产生，他人的评判会尤为显著地影响此类附加意义的导向性……通常，如此产生的附加意义会伴随人终生，并显著地改变人的观念与性格……告解作为一种用于消解不必要的附加意义的行为，理应……

“哎呀，这也太复杂啦，明明是很简单的道理。就想象一只河蚌，能产珍珠的那种。往它身体里面塞一粒沙子，它就会一遍遍地用分泌物去包裹沙粒，直到沙粒不再刺痛它。但告解车是台机器，它可不会对任何东西产生分泌物，它只会帮河蚌把沙子掏出来，然后扔掉。
“换句话说，不管你带进告解车的是喜悦还是烦恼，它都不会擅加评判。跟它多聊一会儿，就会觉得很多事其实也没那么要命——尤其是在你因为CONFESS-47的冷笑话而拼命憋笑的时候。”
——对阅读这篇论文读到头痛欲裂的干员们，能天使如是解释道
